dependencies.label: Capital ceiling
dependencies.claim: Revenue catches the infrastructure build before financing quality decays.

dependencies.label: Power governor
dependencies.claim: Electricity and interconnection constrain the build through the late 2020s.

dependencies.label: Slow diffusion
dependencies.claim: Institutions, workflow and embodiment delay economy-wide substitution.

dependencies.label: Governance lever
dependencies.claim: Capability remains measurable and liability remains allocable.

dependencies.label: Taiwan continuity
dependencies.claim: Leading-edge supply remains geographically brittle but uninterrupted.

dependencies.label: Two economies
dependencies.claim: Cognitive abundance and physical scarcity pull prices apart.

indicators.name: Entry-level : senior hiring
indicators.reading: Entry-level remains about 7% of large-tech hires; the aggregate white-collar recovery test has not resolved.
indicators.assumption: Junior hiring fails to recover even when aggregate hiring does.
indicators.breaks: The apprenticeship-gap mechanism and labor-substitution timing.

indicators.name: AI revenue against capex
indicators.reading: $60B 2025 revenue run-rate against $700–725B 2026 hyperscaler capex guidance.
indicators.assumption: Revenue compounds at 45–55% to absorb the build by 2030.
indicators.breaks: The correction schedule and capital-ceiling mechanism.

indicators.name: Infrastructure financing mix
indicators.reading: Funding is migrating from operating cash flow toward private credit, SPVs and vendor financing.
indicators.assumption: A correction is an orderly pause unless debt makes it propagate.
indicators.breaks: The difference between a spending decision and a credit event.

indicators.name: Grid interconnection wait
indicators.reading: Typical waits remain 5–7 years; active CAISO queue about 523GW and MISO about 380GW.
indicators.assumption: Power remains a physical governor on frontier capacity.
indicators.breaks: The constrained build schedule if a major market halves its wait.

indicators.name: Leading-edge capacity outside Taiwan
indicators.reading: The vast majority of leading-edge logic wafers remain Taiwan-concentrated; alternatives are not at volume yield.
indicators.assumption: Taiwan supply remains concentrated and continuous through 2032.
indicators.breaks: Every compute-gated timeline if continuity fails; consequence shrinks if substitution succeeds.

indicators.name: Verifiable capability gap
indicators.reading: Progress remains strongest where outcomes are cheap to verify; no stable cross-domain series yet closes the gap.
indicators.assumption: Verification, not raw intelligence, governs reliable autonomy.
indicators.breaks: The learned-verification bottleneck and slow-diffusion case.

indicators.name: Autonomy in unstructured physical work
indicators.reading: Commercial deployments remain overwhelmingly scripted, bounded or teleoperated; unstructured autonomy is below 50%.
indicators.assumption: Embodiment keeps physical substitution behind cognitive substitution.
indicators.breaks: The 2030s robotics swing variable and slow-diffusion branch.

indicators.name: Open-weight frontier lag
indicators.reading: The open-weight tier is about 3–6 months behind frontier, already below the authored 9–15 month expectation.
indicators.assumption: Frontier leads decay slowly enough to remain strategically governable.
indicators.breaks: The compute-control lever and the original lab-consolidation clause.

indicators.name: AI liability insurance capacity
indicators.reading: No material AI-specific commercial line has published rates; cyber forms remain the imperfect substitute.
indicators.assumption: Insurers price a legible deployment frontier before correlated losses bind.
indicators.breaks: The accountability moat across medicine, law and autonomous systems.

indicators.name: Cognitive vs physical services inflation
indicators.reading: The directional split is visible in components, but the fixed comparator series has not persisted long enough to score.
indicators.assumption: Cognition gets cheaper while embodied, local services retain pricing power.
indicators.breaks: The two-economy price path and complement-scarcity thesis.
